Entry Common Tongue Common Tongue is spoken throughout much of Westeros, allowing Northerners and Dornishmen to converse at court, in the army, and in the marketplaces. Accents and vocabulary can still reveal one's origin; for those who have never left their hometown, the so-called lingua franca may also be the language others ask them to learn. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
